scope: Signed sensor anomaly effects and bounded scheduled replay inventory

checks.description: migrations 405–414 and 649 apply in order and migration 649 replays cleanly
signed replay inventory returns only matching location/device sensor events
anomaly inventory rejects a location that differs from the signed worker context
signed worker transaction creates the alert, draft claim, notification and approval intent
replay inventory excludes a reading once every current rule has a durable receipt
published event contains the same source-derived context used by channel formatters
follow-up event notification handling is idempotent with the transactionally queued intent
actuator-enabled alert creates only an approval-required intent; no command is sent
source event replay suppresses duplicate alert, notification, and actuator records
real EventBus child commits signed effects, crashes before acknowledgement, then retries on attempt two without duplicate effects
forced-RLS functions work while worker execution has no direct source or effect table reads

network: no external providers contacted; webhook URL is synthetic and used only to select a formatter
